m1781_p0_closure.evidence: M1787 instantiates the frozen M803 adapter once and exposes eight independent bank request/response valid-ready channels with the frozen identity fields.
M1787 implements active+sign typed sources, exact nine-bit negation, eight token identities and 8x96 independent Acc24 state; inactive sources contribute no product.

findings.title: The sealed directed configuration violates the RTL legal-parameter guard and will fatal at time zero
findings.evidence: The TB sets GROUPS=12 and passes SOURCE_GROUPS(GROUPS) to both DUTs. RTL defines STATIC_ACC24_ABS_BOUND=SOURCE_GROUPS*16*128 and PARAMETERS_LEGAL requires this value to equal 98,304. The directed value is 24,576, so g_illegal_parameters executes initial $fatal for both DUTs.
findings.impact: The exact SHA cannot produce the intended single VCS simulation, regardless of the otherwise-correct protocol and arithmetic source.
findings.required_repair: Either run the directed workload at the legal 48-group production point and update ledgers/timeout, or separate the fixed 48-group worst-case proof bound from the reduced directed geometry and legally admit 12..48 groups without weakening the production Acc24 proof. Re-run CPython checks and submit a new different-author source hammer.

findings.title: The nominal duplicate-response attack does not replay a retired legal response identity
findings.evidence: Both attacks assert the same one-bit inject_stale input, which fabricates fixed dead epoch/slot/generation/tag values. The second event repeats a rejected malformed identity; the TB does not save and replay an accepted bank response identity after retirement.
findings.impact: The adapter's already-arrived/retired duplicate protection is not independently exercised even though the author receipt calls duplicate coverage complete.
findings.required_repair: Keep the mismatched/stale attack, then separately capture one accepted bank response's exact epoch/slot/generation/tag and replay it from the same bank after retirement. Require no accept plus sticky protocol/stale status.

findings.title: Reset recovery proves flag clearing but not restored legal service, and the authored SVA cover does not match the three-cycle reset
findings.evidence: After the attack the TB holds reset for three clocks, checks protocol_error/stale_response_seen clear, and ends without loading another legal bundle. cp_reset_recovery encodes exactly one reset cycle before deassertion, so the directed three-cycle reset cannot satisfy that cover sequence.
findings.impact: A partially reset cache/adapter/accumulator path could pass the present reset check, and the named cover is expected to remain zero.
findings.required_repair: After reset, run a minimal legal request-response-bridge-commit-terminal transaction and make the SVA recovery sequence accept the actual reset duration.

findings.title: Author 12/12 tests do not cross-check the reduced reference geometry against RTL parameter legality
findings.evidence: The Python model deliberately computes twelve groups, while the static checker only searches for the 98,304 token and never evaluates PARAMETERS_LEGAL at the TB override. Thus all author tests pass despite guaranteed time-zero fatal.
findings.impact: PASS_12_OF_12 is a source/reference receipt, not launch readiness.
findings.required_repair: Add a mutation-sensitive test that evaluates every elaborated TB parameter tuple against the RTL legal-point predicate.

disposition.reason: Both M1781 architectural blockers are now represented in source, but the sealed directed point cannot start and two required protocol recovery attacks remain incomplete.
